# Variable `SETUPTOOLS_BUILD_ARGS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When used by recipes that inherit the setuptools3 class, this variable can be used to specify additional arguments to be passed to `setup.py build` in the `setuptools3_do_compile()` task.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SETUPTOOLS_BUILD_ARGS)
